Check powder filling and seal clearance Share bulk density, target fill weight and the filling method. Confirm that the opening accommodates the filling nozzle or scoop and leaves room for a clean final seal. Check a filled sample with the actual powder before fixing the pouch dimensions. Check the bottom gusset Confirm the bottom gusset, filled footprint and stability at the intended fill level. Keep artwork clear of the base fold and seals. Review the filled sample against shelf depth before fixing the dieline. Review zipper access and final sealing Confirm zipper location, usable opening and the final top-seal allowance. Check filling access, opening and reclosing with the actual contents. Include any valve as a separate specified component.
